value.rationale: A complete metric dihedral-angle distribution is an intrinsic angular invariant in the standard root embedding, not a rephrasing of face counts or facet areas. The sharp right/obtuse distinction, all angle-level multiplicities, non-Gaussian fluctuations and rare-ridge-dominated variance together reveal a natural geometrical phenomenon for the whole \(K_{2,q}\) family, beyond routine isolated numerical values.
